chars.ADAM: ADAM: a very tall, extremely skinny young man (stick-thin arms and legs) wearing an oversized pale blue short-sleeve shirt hanging loose on him, beige chino trousers and white sneakers.
chars.GIRL: GIRL: a young Moroccan woman wearing a mustard-yellow knit cardigan over a white top, wide light-blue jeans and a dark brown long hair scarf-free ponytail style shown as a small brown bun on her round white head.
chars.BIG: BIG: a huge muscular bodybuilder young man with giant arms and a wide chest, wearing a tight black sleeveless tank top, grey jogger pants and a thin silver chain.
chars.FRIENDS: FRIENDS: two young men, one in a red hoodie and one in a green bomber jacket, both in dark jeans.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Evening house party in a modern Casablanca apartment living room with fairy lights, other guests blurred far in the background. GIRL smiles and talks to ADAM, ADAM stands stiffly, surprised and shy, hands behind his back. Both standing face to face in the centre.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Same Casablanca apartment party. GIRL gestures enthusiastically while chatting, ADAM forces a nervous awkward smile, sweating a little, scratching the back of his head.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Same party living room, crowded, all sofas are taken by blurred guests in the background. ADAM and GIRL stand together looking around for a free seat, ADAM points at a corner.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Same party. ADAM walks proudly across the room carrying a white plastic chair with both hands above the floor, chest puffed out, confident smile, a few blurred guests far behind.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Same party. BIG suddenly grabs the white plastic chair out of ADAM's hands with one huge arm. ADAM, shocked, mouth open, still reaching for it. BIG towers over ADAM. Comic contrast of skinny vs muscular.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Same party. BIG holds the white plastic chair casually, smirking down at ADAM with a fake apologetic hand gesture as if saying sorry I did not see you. ADAM looks tiny and confused next to him.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Same party. FRIENDS burst out laughing, bent over, pointing towards the left side of the picture, BIG laughing with them, sitting on the white plastic chair.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Same party. Close medium shot of ADAM in the centre with a bright red embarrassed face, fists clenched, not smiling, jaw tight. GIRL stands behind him a little to the side, looking at him unsure.
